speaker: Rose Delgado
cascadeSummary: I voted to advance the Fruitvale Transit Hub Phase II design consultant selection to keep momentum on a vital community project. I also supported expanding the Oakland Alternative Response Initiative to District 3, recognizing its proven effectiveness in improving public safety. Finally, I highlighted the success of Fruitvale's street trade this cycle as a result of targeted neighborhood investment.

statements.quote: Phase II's blueprints belong to the merchants who'll live with them—we're signing more than a contract, we're signing a covenant.
statements.fullStatement: The Fruitvale Transit Hub is a generational investment in our community. This design consultant selection moves us from vision to reality while upholding the merchant protections we fought for. I vote YES to keep this project on track.

statements.quote: Safety isn't a template — it's a tailored approach that meets neighborhoods where they are.
statements.fullStatement: The Oakland Alternative Response Initiative has proven its value in Districts 1 and 2. Expanding it to District 3 will bring that same proven model of community-responsive public safety to Fruitvale and San Antonio.

statements.quote: Fruitvale's bustling street trade isn't luck — it's the result of deliberate investment in our neighborhoods.
statements.fullStatement: This cycle's boosted street trade in Fruitvale shows what happens when we invest in our neighborhoods. It's proof that targeted funding, merchant support, and community engagement get results.
